newsitem.title: USA: Sen. Lott says Clinton Medicare estimate realistic.
newsitem.headline: Sen. Lott says Clinton Medicare estimate realistic.

text.p: Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott Tuesday called President Clinton's Medicare savings estimate "realistic."

In a statement, the Republican from Mississippi, said: "I am encouraged that the President has presented a more realistic estimate of the savings needed to make the Medicare program solvent for the next decade."
Clinton Tuesday proposed $138 billion in Medicare savings over six years, saying he wanted to meet Republicans half way in the effort to reach a compromise balanced budget plan.
"We will certainly examine this budget proposal carefully, so that we can begin to move toward a common solution to the crisis faced by the possible bankruptcy of the Medicare system," Lott said.
